items.source_title: Interaction Patterns and Embodied Design Processes Using an AI Robotics Kit for K–12 Education
items.source_locator: ACM Digital Library 文章頁（管理者 2026-10-16 截圖）：Just Accepted；Accepted on 17 September 2026；Online AM: 15 October 2026；出版者 PDF（Just Accepted 版，管理者提供）：ACM 1946-6226/2026/10-ART；Abstract
items.original_excerpt: We conducted three researcher-led interventions with children aged 10, 11 and 13, each tasked to build an AI-enhanced robot using the robotics kit.
